title: CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS
mv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
mvp: “The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.” Proverbs 14:8 (NKJV)
outline: Seek And Be Guided By Knowledge
assignment: Mention five (5) common internet-enabled devices that need to be protected (2X5=10 marks).

b.x: Cybersecurity is a process of safeguarding all our internet-enabled ‘front’ from prying eyes and unwanted third-party exposure to avoid being exploited and defrauded. Many people lack the basic ‘lookouts’ to give them warnings, or sentries on their cyber perimeters; thereby leaving their cyber gates unguarded against intrusion. Social platforms, email services, search engines, websites, online payment services, banking apps, etc., have enormous benefits. But these platforms can be manipulated to hurt us. We must pay attention to how we interact with whatever forms part of our ecosystem, the potential benefits and the risks it poses to our lives.

i: False sense of security: Antivirus, password, passcode, and biometrics only secure devices to an extent. However, Cyber criminals (people who use technology for malicious and illegal acts, typically for financial gain) and hackers (individuals who gain access to your internet enabled gadgets without permission to cause havoc) will always start with a bait such as phishing (Sending fake emails, messages, chats to trick people into revealing sensitive information like passwords or credit card numbers to commit fraud), links, network scan of the environment, etc. (Judges 18:7; Proverbs 2:10-12). Anyone who falls into this trap would have revealed their password or passcode, etc., to the hackers. Beware!

Be Proactive: Learn how to change your router default passwords, restrict the number of users and IP address ranges to what is required. This will help you to know when there is an intruder in your network. Pay attention to website addresses. Does it have Https (Safe) or Http (unsafe)? Instead of clicking on a link, try to access the website directly using the web address. Ensure the link you want to click is the right one (Proverbs 24:6). sections.h: SEEK AND BE GUIDED BY KNOWLEDGE

b.x: Search out knowledge on the devices you have (Ecclesiastes 7:25). Know how your ISP Router or MiFi works and how to prevent an intruder from gaining access to your network (Proverbs 9:12). Ensure you protect all the pictures and videos saved on the phones, should the phone be lost or hacked.

Security is intentional, not accidental. Scrutinise the sender of attachments and links before opening them (Ephesians 5:15; Colossians 4:5). Many people who have internet-enabled CCTV in their house are being watched by someone else without their knowledge. This is because someone might be within your home network without your knowledge, as the device is configured to allow up to 10 users at a time. To avoid this, reduce the setting to one user and monitor it. Do not be like the people of Laish (Judges 18:7), think security!

Think about Script Kiddies (Yahoo boys). Some of them are learning the act of cyber fraud, and so they test and check devices in their environment. If by accident they are in your network, they can exploit you without you being aware. So, connect with and learn from experts to have a minimum-security setting for your PCs, CCTV and Routers (Proverbs 11:8; 24:3).
Research and invest in security devices that will alert you when there is an intruder.
